The '''Gran constabulary''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The [[Capra Spaceport]] was initially managed by the constabulary, though the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventuallly took over.<ref name="Strongholds" />
